connector.name: Attio MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: AI-powered Attio CRM access. Manage contacts, companies, deals, tasks, notes and workflows.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package attio-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kesslerio account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ATTIO_API_KEY
env.description: Your Attio API key (required for all tools except health-check)

env.name: ATTIO_WORKSPACE_ID
env.description: Optional Attio workspace ID for workspace-specific operations

env.name: ATTIO_MCP_TOOL_MODE
env.description: Tool mode: 'full' (all tools) or 'search' (search tools only). Default: 'full'
